title: A névelő: a, az, egy
summary: “The” is a before a consonant and az before a vowel. “A / an” is always egy.

sections.text: The **határozott névelő** (definite article, “the”) has two forms. Just like English “a / an”, the choice depends on the **sound** that starts the next word.

head: Next word starts with
Article
Examples
rows: a gitár, a kávé, a csokoládé
az autó, az óra, az íróasztal

sections.text: Digraphs count as consonants: **a dzsip**, **a zsiráf**. Foreign words follow the first sound too: **a whisky** (w is a consonant), **az internet**.
The indefinite article is **egy**, which is also the number one. It never changes.
Try it: type a word and get its article.
